plan.notes: Official UW-La Crosse Catalog Biology Major BS sample degree plan (Total Credits: 120 as published; 16+15+14+15+13+16+15+16 = 120). The major is 39 credits (58-61 total including CHM/MTH requirements); a minimum of three 400-level BIO credits required. CSH Core slots recorded generically per the published plan (300/400 not BIO or Minor / individualized option). CGER placeholders recorded with their published categories. Catalog edition year not printed on catalog.uwlax.edu pages; current edition as accessed 2026-10-10.
